reviews.text: Our master bath tub was in really bad condition. It started chipping and got worse over the last few years. I found Francisco through Facebook marketplace. He had posted some before and after pictures of tubs he had refinished. I read his reviews and decided to reach out via FB Messenger. He responded within ten minutes and asked me to send pictures. He provided a quote and we were able to set up an appointment that same week. The day of the job, he arrived on time. He worked the entire time without a break and did an amazing job. We could not be happier with the results. I would highly recommend this company. He did excellent work.

Francisco was very professional in every aspect of the job. He taped off the whole bathroom so there was no overspray. He showed up on time and had great communication. I was going to get a new tub but glad I decided to go this route instead as the tub looks brand new. I highly recommend Francisco!
Francisco was extremely professional, prompt, patient and took the time to explain the process in detail. He answered each and every question I had. My tub looks brand new!
